items.question: Which law governs the warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The warehouse lease is governed by the law of England and Wales. This is stated in the document "Unit 7 Lease" at clause 10.1, which says, "This Lease is governed by the law of England and Wales" [1].

Another document, "Harrowgate MSA," mentions a different governing law, stating that the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware [3]. However, this document is not the warehouse lease in question.

A separate document, "Northbridge NDA," also refers to England and Wales as the governing law, but this is a different agreement [4].

evidence.quote: This Lease is governed by the law of England and Wales
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
This Agreement is governed by the law of England and Wales

items.question: What work does the Calder & Wynne engagement cover?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter does not specify the exact work covered by the engagement. The documents provided only include the terms of termination and liability, but not the scope of the services rendered.

The engagement may be terminated by either party with written notice, and the client will be responsible for fees for work completed up to that point [2].

The firm's liability is capped at GBP 5 million in connection with the engagement [3].

evidence.quote: Either of us may end this engagement at any time by written notice. You will pay our fees for work done up to that point.
Our aggregate liability to you in connection with this engagement is limited to GBP 5 million.

items.question: Is the service credit cap set per month or per year?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that the service credit cap is set per calendar month. Specifically, the text states, "Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month" [1].

This suggests that the cap applies to each individual month, not across a year. There is no mention of a yearly cap in the provided sources.
